# Pull Request Template

## Summary
Provide a clear and concise description of the changes made.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Governance update
- [ ] Compliance update
- [ ] Documentation

## Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles with zero warnings
- [ ] Tests added or updated (`forge test -vvv`)
- [ ] Events emitted for critical state changes
- [ ] Security checks (reentrancy, access control) verified
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, GOVERNANCE, COMPLIANCE)
- [ ] Linked to relevant issue or proposal

## Governance Impact
- Covenant or contract affected
- Governance principle (fairness, transparency, accountability)
- Compliance reference (ISO 27001, ISO 42001, SOC 3, CSA STAR)

## Additional Notes
Add any other context or screenshots about the pull request here.
